decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed erection of  single-storey rear extension, replacement of front porch, erection of a two storey side extension, erection of a roof extension, incorporating roof lights to the front elevation and conversion of the existing garage to a habitable room .would, by reason of its  size, position and appearance in relation to  neighbouring residential properties, be unduly obtrusive, detrimental to the amenities of adjoining occupiers  and is contrary to the Policies  ENVB 1.1 (New Development)   and H.6.4 Extensions and Alterations) of the  Unitary Development Plan, (2003) and Supplementary Planning Guidance, Residential Extension Guidelines.
description: Erection of single storey rear extension, replacement of existing front porch, erection of two storey side extension, erection of roof extension incorporating rooflights to front elevation and conversion of existing garage to a habitable room to house.
